description: Summarise how currencies moved against `base` over a window: start/end rate, change %, strengthened % (positive = stronger vs base), and optional min/max/avg. Use for questions like "how did EUR do over 10 years" and for movers rankings. Omit `currencies` to rank the universe (movers mode); provide them to compare specific ones. Use `get_history` for raw points, and the other `analyze_*` tools for volatility, correlation, drawdown, safe-haven, or mean-reversion questions. Defaults: 20-year window, `base` USD, `sort` strengthened, `assetClass` fiat, `limit` 10, `stats` true. Returns `{ base, from, to, mode, sort?, assetClass?, stats, results[] }`. A 404 means no rate data at the window edges. Requires a signed-in connection and the Growth plan or higher; each successful call bills 1 API request.

assetClass.description: Movers universe: fiat (default, liquid tradeable currencies), metals (XAU/XAG/XPT/XPD), all (every currency including illiquid/frontier), or crypto (accepted, but this FX dataset has no crypto data, so results are empty). Redenomination artifacts are always dropped.

base.description: Currency everything is measured against (3-letter ISO 4217). Defaults to USD.

currencies.description: Comma-separated currencies to compare, e.g. GBP,EUR,AED. OMIT to rank ALL currencies vs base ('movers' mode).

from.description: Window start YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to 20 years (2 decades) before `to`. See `period` for a shorthand.

interval.description: Attach a trend series per named currency: weekly, monthly, or yearly (compare mode only).

limit.description: Movers: how many top results to return (default 10, max 200).

period.description: Relative window shorthand for `from`: e.g. 10y, 6m, 30d, ytd, max. Ignored if `from` is given.

stats.description: Include min/max/avg over the window per currency. Defaults to true; pass false to skip.

to.description: Window end YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to today; a future date clamps to today.

name: analyze_history
title: History analysis (change, trend, movers)
